topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 29 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (delegationsharebase, delegationcallbackbase, crossdomainenabled). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
